current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page (last modified 25 September 2026) still links only this 'Validation guidance - National and local list' PDF, and the PDF text reads V04, adopted March 2016. A web search found no newer official list.

issues.detail: The council's current list is about 10 years old (V04, March 2016). It cites the EIA Regulations 2011, draft Local Plan 'Modification' thresholds and the old A1/A3-A5 use classes, so some triggers are superseded in practice. Grokbot flags it as outdated, which is correct, but users should be warned that its thresholds may no longer match policy.
issues.evidence: Validation guidance - National and Local Lists V04, Adopted March 2016

issues.detail: Grokbot put Coal Mining Risk Assessment under Householder. The source applies it to all NON-householder applications in the Coal Mining Reporting Area, in high-risk areas only.
issues.evidence: Coal Mining Risk Assessment: 'All non householder applications which fall within the Coal Mining Reporting Area'

issues.detail: Grokbot filed Employment/Economic Statement, Lighting Assessment, and Existing and proposed site levels/sections under Listed building consent. The source ties them to triggers, not to LBC: Loss of Employment Statement where employment floorspace or land is lost; Lighting where external lighting is provided near homes, listed buildings, conservation areas or open countryside; site sections for any change of floor level or new building. Most other items carry the generic 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' note (e.g. Flood Risk Assessment, Heritage Statement, Structural Survey). The source applies these by trigger to any application type: Structural Survey, for example, also covers demolition in a conservation area.
issues.evidence: Local list rows for Loss of Employment, Lighting assessment, Structural survey

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture these local requirements: Affordable Housing Statement (settlements under 3,000 pop: 0.17 ha or 5+ dwellings; elsewhere 0.5 ha or 15+ dwellings); Agricultural worker / rural enterprise dwelling appraisal (new agricultural dwellings; removal of occupancy conditions); Air Quality Assessment (within or adjacent to an AQMA); Building for Life 12 assessment (all major housing); Energy/Sustainability Statement (5+ dwellings or 500 sq m+ non-residential); Mineral Water Assessment (proposals affecting Buxton natural mineral water); Noise Impact Assessment (noise-sensitive or noise-generating development); Parking information (applications affecting parking); Telecommunications provision (masts outside PD); Town centre sequential and impact tests (retail/leisure over 2,500 sq m outside centres); Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment (strategic applications); Ventilation and Extraction Statement (A3/A4/A5 uses); Waste management / storage and collection plan (major 10+ dwellings and most new development); Tree survey / arboricultural statement (trees in or adjacent to the site, TPO/CA trees, protected hedgerows); Landscaping scheme (all major applications).

Many trigger excerpts come from the wrong row. Open space: the excerpt is contamination text ('schools, allotments, playing fields ... environmental screening report'), but the source trigger is any loss of public or private open space. Travel Plan: the excerpt is Heads of Terms/affordable housing text, but the source says developments generating significant movements, e.g. 2,500 sq m+ non-residential. Viability Assessment: the excerpt is Heritage Statement text. Habitats Regulations: the excerpt ends with occupancy-condition text ('proof that the dwelling is no longer needed'). Photographs: the excerpt is archaeology text. Advertisement drawings: the excerpt is a bare fragment ('levels of illumination and extent of light spillage.').
issues.evidence: Open Space Assessment row: 'any loss of public or private open space including playing fields, recreation grounds and allotments'

issues.detail: The Contaminated Land trigger begins with an officer's email address ('Steve.Baker@derbyshire.gov.uk'), a contact detail. The 'Roof plan' row is the fragment 'plans and roof plans.' The Drawing standards tab_items and the Floor plans row under prior approval are national plan standards, not local requirements. Design and Access Statement and Environmental Statement are national/statutory.

summary: The workbook link works and is still the council's only published list, but that list dates from March 2016 and is clearly old. Grokbot captured roughly half of the ~30 local requirements, wrongly put Coal Mining Risk Assessment under Householder (the source excludes householder applications), and many trigger excerpts are taken from adjacent rows.
